whyUs.title: The
whyUs.subtitle: We are not just another ski school. We are a community of passionate instructors dedicated to making your mountain experience unforgettable.

certified.title: Certified Instructors
certified.description: All our instructors are ISIA certified with years of experience teaching skiers of all levels. Learn from the best in Bakuriani.

safety.title: Safety First
safety.description: Your safety is our priority. All instructors are trained in first aid and avalanche safety. We provide comprehensive insurance coverage.

flexible.title: Flexible Scheduling
flexible.description: Book lessons at your convenience. Easy rescheduling up to 24 hours in advance.

personalized.title: Personalized Approach
personalized.description: Every skier is unique. Our instructors tailor their teaching methods to your learning style, goals, and pace for maximum progress.

local.title: Local Expertise
local.description: Our instructors know every slope, powder stash, and hidden gem in Bakuriani. Get insider tips on the best runs for your level.

guarantee.title: Satisfaction Guaranteed
guarantee.description: Not satisfied with your lesson? We will make it right with a free follow-up session. Your happiness is our success metric.

testimonials.title: What Our
testimonials.subtitle: Do not just take our word for it. Hear from skiers who have transformed their skills with our instructors.

faq.title: Frequently Asked
faq.subtitle: Got questions? We have got answers. If you can not find what you are looking for, feel free to contact us.
faq.contactText: Our team is here to help. Reach out and we will get back to you within 24 hours.

bring.question: What should I bring to my ski lesson?
bring.answer: Please bring your ski equipment (skis, boots, poles), valid ski pass, warm clothing, gloves, goggles, and sunscreen. If you need equipment rental, we can recommend trusted rental shops in Bakuriani.

duration.question: How long are the lessons?
duration.answer: All our standard lessons are 2 hours long. This is the optimal duration for effective learning while maintaining energy and focus throughout the session.

kids.question: Can I book a lesson for my child?
kids.answer: Absolutely! We have instructors specialized in teaching children. Kids lessons are available for ages 4 and up. We focus on safety, fun, and building confidence on the slopes.

cancel.question: What if I need to cancel or reschedule?
cancel.answer: We understand plans can change. You can reschedule or cancel your booking up to 24 hours before the lesson for a full refund. Cancellations within 24 hours are subject to a 50% fee.

group.question: Do you offer group discounts?
group.answer: Yes! Group lessons are a great way to learn with friends or family. We offer discounts for groups of 3 or more. Contact us for custom group packages.

languages.question: What languages do the instructors speak?
languages.answer: Our instructors speak multiple languages including English, Georgian, Russian, German, French, and Spanish. You can filter instructors by language when booking.
